name: What accessibility modifications can be added during a bathroom fixture update?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility modifications can be added during a bathroom fixture update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility fixture upgrades improve safety and mobility without sacrificing interior design quality. Key options include installing comfort-height toilets, zero-threshold roll-in showers, thermostatic anti-scald mixing valves, and wall-anchored grab bars. Grab bar installation requires structural backing, meaning the wall framing behind drywall or tile must be reinforced with solid wood blocking to support weight safely. Lever-style or touchless faucets are also practical additions for individuals with arthritis or limited grip strength.
acceptedAnswer.description: Options include comfort-height toilets, walk-in shower valves, lever faucets, and grab bars, which require solid wood blocking inside walls for secure mounting.
